Where's General Skywalker?''"
"''He'll be here.|This clone trooper and Captain Rex, during the Battle of Teth|}} This clone trooper, a member of [[Torrent Company]], which was part of the [[501st Legion]], participated in the [[Battle of Teth]] in [[22 BBY]] and was one of the few members of his unit to survive the battle. ==Biography== {{Quote|This is it! Scrap 'em!|Captain Rex to the clone trooper|}} In [[22 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' to [[22 BBY]]. after the [[Battle of Christophsis]], [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], along with [[Torrent Company]] of the [[501st Legion]], went to the [[planet]] [[Teth]] to rescue [[Rotta]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba's]] [[Gender|son]], who was being held captive in the [[B'omarr Monastery]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. On the way to the monastery, their [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry|gunships]] were [[Battle of Teth|fired upon]] by [[battle droid]]s, but they managed to land near the base of the [[mountain]] atop which it was located without any casualties. Skywalker, Tano, [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]] and the other members of Torrent Company fought against the [[droid]]s while scaling the ridge of the mountain. They successfully breached the monastery and located the [[Hutt|Huttlet]], but [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] forces attacked them again, forcing the remaining troops back inside the temple. The two [[Jedi]], along with [[R2-D2]], took Rotta to search for an escape route, while the [[Cloning|clones]] remained at the main entrance to delay the droids. After Separatist forces led by [[Asajj Ventress]] breached the temple, the surviving members of Torrent Company, including this trooper, were taken prisoner. When Skywalker attempted to contact Rex through his [[comlink]], a pair of [[B1-series battle droid|B1 battle droids]] who were guarding the prisoners attempted to investigate the source of the sound. When one of them leaned in for a closer look, Rex told the droid that he would show it "how it works" before punching it and taking its blaster. The othet clones followed suit and, Rex and this clone trooper began taking cover behind the leg joint of an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer|AT-TE walker]]. The trooper warned the captain that they couldn't hold out much longer, and asked where General Skywalker was. The captain reassured the trooper that he would be there. Later on, the trooper destroyed a [[Vulture-class starfighter|vulture droid]] by shooting out its head and arm joints. Rex called for a last stand, telling his men to 'scrap' the other droids before both jumped from the AT-TE. Eventually, the two clones became surrounded by battle droids. One of the droids told the clones to surrender, to which the captain replied that the droids were outnumbered. The droid began counting its allies before Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], flying his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor|starfighter]], destroyed them. The battle continued as [[Clone Commander|Commander]] [[Cody]] arrived, along with members of the [[7th Sky Corps]], and the [[Galactic Republic]] was eventually able to successfully extract the surviving members of Torrent Company. ==Personality and traits== The clone trooper was observant, understanding that, being outnumbered by the battle droids, their unit would be defeated without help. They were intelligent and had excellent tactical knowledge, shooting a vulture droid in the leg so they would fall. ==Equipment== The clone trooper wore [[Color|white]] [[Phase I clone trooper armor]] in combat and, after being taken prisoner by the droids and attacking them along with the rest of their company, used an [[E-5 blaster rifle]] taken from a droid. ==Behind the scenes== The clone trooper first appeared in the [[2008]] film [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']]. They, like all clone troopers in the film, were voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]]. ==Appearances== *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Clone troopers]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Members of the 501st Legion (Galactic Republic)]] [[Category:Members of Torrent Company]]
